fieldNotes.truckGate: Main entrance off Unisia Dr is an open, divided driveway with a 'Walmart DC 6055' monument sign (2018 + 2021 + 2026 Street View) and NO barrier arm or sliding gate across the public-road throat. Classified false: no controlled checkpoint at the property line.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth resolved at the open road entrance in any Street View vintage. A chain-link-fenced tractor/yard-truck compound sits inside the property (visible in 2018 SV looking W/SW from inside), but the security gate to that compound was not clearly imaged; left guardShack false. Low confidence on interior gatehouse.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because truckGate classified false (open entrance). If an interior fenced-yard gate exists it would be kiosk/badge controlled, but not evidenced at the public entrance.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard/queue area between the open entrance and the dock faces and fenced trailer yard provides ample interior staging.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance driveway from Unisia Dr to the docks/yard is long (~250m+) and easily holds 3+ trucks; deep approach.
fieldNotes.entryExitTogether: Single shared entrance/exit off Unisia Dr (the only road frontage; S and E sides are woods/pond). entryLanes/exitLanes ~2 each across the divided drive.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide divided entrance apron with substantial unused paved width; room to add a bypass/express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 50+ band. Dock doors counted across three faces: west face of the main (south) building (~40-50 doors, trailers backed in), south/SE face of the main building (~30+ doors), and the south face of the north building (~40+ doors). Total estimated ~150.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ band. Extensive trailer drop yard on the NW with many parallel rows of parked drop trailers (no tractors); estimated 200+ drop stalls.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Likely separate ship/receive — distinct dock banks on different building faces (north building south face vs main building west and south faces). Medium confidence from overhead only.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale/weigh pad clearly identified in the entrance path; left false.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Two connected structures: a long E-W north building and a large square main distribution building (grocery/perishable). Counted as 2.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; nearest rail is not connected. False.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial park outside Monroe GA, surrounded by woods, pond, and farmland; classified Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: ~220 trailers visible across drop yard, dock faces, and overflow rows in captured z17-z18 imagery; honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: On a developed industrial park with adjacent DCs and a major retailer; cellular coverage likely adequate. False.
